# LAMMPS input script for bulk aluminum energy calculation

units metal
atom_style atomic

# Read structure
read_data aluminum.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
min_style cg
min_modify dmax 0.1
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output final energy
variable natoms equal "count(all)"
variable etotal equal "pe"
variable eatom equal "v_etotal/v_natoms"

print "Total atoms: ${natoms}"
print "Total energy: ${etotal} eV"
print "Energy per atom: ${eatom} eV/atom"

# LAMMPS input script for surface aluminum energy calculation

units metal
atom_style atomic

# Read structure
read_data aluminum.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Change boundary conditions - remove periodicity in z
change_box all boundary p p s

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
min_style cg
min_modify dmax 0.1
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output final energy and box dimensions
variable natoms equal "count(all)"
variable etotal equal "pe"
variable eatom equal "v_etotal/v_natoms"
variable lx equal "lx"
variable ly equal "ly"
variable lz equal "lz"
variable area equal "v_lx*v_ly"

print "Total atoms: ${natoms}"
print "Total energy: ${etotal} eV"
print "Energy per atom: ${eatom} eV/atom"
print "Box dimensions: Lx=${lx} Ly=${ly} Lz=${lz}"
print "Surface area: ${area} Angstrom^2"

min_modify dmax 0.1

minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Calculate surface energy for Aluminum [001] surface

# Energies from LAMMPS simulations
E_bulk = -1679.86275358002  # eV
E_surface = -1631.81097242534  # eV
A = 407.8238886225  # Angstrom^2

# Calculate surface energy
# Formula: gamma = (E_surface - E_bulk) / (2 * A)
# Factor of 2 because slab has two surfaces

E_diff = E_surface - E_bulk
print(f"Energy difference (E_surface - E_bulk): {E_diff} eV")

surface_energy = E_diff / (2 * A)
print(f"Surface energy: {surface_energy} eV/Angstrom^2")
print(f"Surface energy (rounded to 2 decimals): {surface_energy:.2f}")
